HOW IT WORKS

You send the brief. We build the invitation.

No editor to learn, no template to fight. Pick a design, send us the wedding, and we hand back a live link your client can share on WhatsApp the same week.

Browse designs
See pricing
Six steps, start to share

Under twenty minutes of studio time per wedding.

01

Browse designs with your client

Filter by celebration and language. Every design opens as a live invitation on a phone, because that is where it will be read.

02

Order from your studio panel

You choose the design and link duration and pay through Razorpay — cards, UPI, net-banking and wallets. The order sits in your panel with the booking.

03

Send the details

One form: names, events, venues, timings, the blessing at the top. Save it and come back — or give the couple their scoped client login and let them fill it in.

04

We build it

A designer sets the details into the design, checks the typography in both scripts, and proofs it end to end.

05

We deliver a live link

You get a link and a QR code. Approve it, or send one round of corrections

OUR STORY

An invitation should feel like an invitation

Not a form. Not a template you fight with at 1am three weeks before the wedding. MAJA started because a photographer kept rebuilding the same invitation by hand for every couple, and thought the couple should not have to do it either.

We are a small team in India building for Indian weddings first — multiple ceremonies, several languages on one card, families spread across three time zones, and a guest list where half the people will open the link on a phone with two bars of signal. Those constraints shaped everything here.

01
We build it, you do not

Most digital invitation products hand you a drag-and-drop editor and call that a service. Planning a wedding is already a second job. You send us the names, the dates, the photos and whatever else you have; a person on our team builds the invitation and sends it back as a link.

02
A guest should never need an account

Nobody wants to sign up to see a wedding invitation. Every guest-facing thing we make — the invitation, the RSVP, the wishes wall, the photo gallery, the face search — works from a link with nothing to install and nothing to join.
